eternal: Nihil's Doom grants power and both armors while damaging heroes, growing permanently on level-ups and takedowns.
Growing Threat with Adaptive Plating is the best Nihil pair in this jungle field.

threats: Chain-CC risk (1 hard-CC abilities, ~0.5s of lockdown): Iggy & Scorch Inferno (knockback). Don't group tight into it — stagger the engage and hold mobility/cleanse for the key one.
Dive threat on our backline: Yurei. Assign peel for the carry and ward the flanks.
synergy: Our engage/CC: Crunch Right Crunch (knockup 1.25s), Lt. Belica Neural Disruptor (silence 0.5s). Our kills come from landing burst INSIDE that CC window — whoever lands it, the rest must follow up immediately.
We have sustain (Steel) — favor the longer fight where our heals out-grind them.
Strong AoE/teamfight kit — group at choke points and fight on top of objectives.

ourKits.combo: Forward Crunch dashes in to stun, Left Crunch and Right Crunch build Turbo, then the Turbo Crunch version (long push dash, true-damage double swipe, or knockup uppercut) lands, with Re-Crunch repeating the last ability
ourKits.winCondition: chain abilities into Turbo Crunch empowered hits and heal through Re-Crunch's passive
ourKits.passive: each ability empowers his next basic attack and cuts his cooldowns; two ability casts activate Turbo Crunch, enhancing his next basic ability
ourKits.playWith: engage and peel-stripping teammates so he can reach the backline
ourKits.playAgainst: fight after Forward Crunch is used, since it is his long-cooldown gap closer; respect his second ability cast because the next one is Turbo-enhanced; anti-heal blunts Re-Crunch healing and armor helps against his physical damage

ourKits.combo: Root a target with Static Trap, shred armor with Buckshot, stack attack speed with Hot Pursuit and finish with the long-range Charged shot or Long Arm of the Law.
ourKits.winCondition: Control space with traps and out-range enemies with Charged basic attacks, then snipe low targets anywhere with Long Arm of the Law.
ourKits.passive: Shots Fired: after 5 landed basic attacks his next one gains extra range and bonus damage.
ourKits.playWith: A frontline or peeling support, since his only escape tools are Buckshot's push back and Hot Pursuit's speed.
ourKits.playAgainst: Avoid fighting over Static Traps and engage after Buckshot is used, since it is his push-back peel. Stay out of the ult line at low health; armor does not help against Long Arm of the Law.

ourKits.combo: First Intent dash in for a shield, Ashen Vow outer edge to slow and empower Cindara, Swan Song to restrain the target and set her blade Ablaze, then Minueta stabs to execute.
ourKits.winCondition: Land Swan Song on a key target to restrain them and spend the Ablaze window with longer range and more power, finishing with Minueta.
ourKits.passive: Last Light: she uses Energy instead of Mana, restores Energy on takedowns, and turns bonus mana into physical power.
ourKits.playWith: Engage or CC teammates who group enemies for Ashen Vow and help her reach the restrained target.
ourKits.playAgainst: Ashen Vow has a short channel and its slow is on the outer edge, so step inside or away. She is Unstoppable during Swan Song, so save CC for after it; fight her after First Intent's shield is spent. Armor answers her physical damage.

ourKits.combo: Void Drone for vision and mana drain, Seismic Assault to knock up and stun, Void Bomb, then Neural Disruptor to silence and finish.
ourKits.winCondition: Drain mana with Void Drone and land Seismic Assault, then burst with Neural Disruptor's missing-mana damage.
ourKits.passive: Innovation upgrades each ability at max rank and grants ability haste.
ourKits.playWith: Follow-up damage during Seismic Assault's knockup and stun.
ourKits.playAgainst: Seismic Assault erupts after a short delay, so sidestep the line. Avoid casting near Void Drone since it zaps and drains mana, and dive her after Seismic Assault is used; magical armor helps.

ourKits.combo: Bull Rush in unstoppable to knock back → Shield Bash stun → Shield Slam knockup and stun, Force Shield to block projectiles
ourKits.winCondition: engage with Shield Slam or Bull Rush and protect carries with Force Shield's projectile wall
ourKits.passive: a self-shield that lasts until broken and refreshes when out of damage, plus hybrid armor
ourKits.playWith: ranged carries he can shield from enemy projectiles, and follow-up damage for his engages
ourKits.playAgainst: Bull Rush is unstoppable, so do not waste CC into it; walk around Force Shield instead of shooting into it, and fight after Shield Slam is on cooldown

enemyKits.combo: Ambush leap and slow, Unleash for maximum attack speed cleaving basics, Cull to lock the target, Invigorate to cleanse and heal.
enemyKits.winCondition: Stick to one target, build Rage for regen and faster cooldowns, and out-sustain them in long fights.
enemyKits.passive: Ancestral Fury builds Rage on hits, giving health regen and faster cooldowns, plus movement speed at high Rage.
enemyKits.playAgainst: Buy anti-heal to cut Invigorate and Rage regen. Save your CC until after Invigorate is used since it cleanses, and break off for a few seconds so his Rage decays.

enemyKits.combo: Oil Spill to slow, Molotov to ignite the oil, Flame Turrets to keep shooting, then Inferno and its knockback belch.
enemyKits.winCondition: Layer oil, fire and turrets on a choke or objective and burn the team that has to stand in it.
enemyKits.passive: Badlands Critter basics stack Slick, a slow that lets his fire ignite the target.
enemyKits.playWith: CC that holds enemies in his fire and oil.
enemyKits.playAgainst: Do not fight in his oil and fire; flank around it. Melee basics break Flame Turrets quickly, and turrets go inactive when he moves away from them, so drag the fight off them; magical armor helps.

enemyKits.combo: Piercing Shot poke → Heightened Senses for attack speed → Hail of Arrows slow → Inner Fire barrage
enemyKits.winCondition: stack Relentless with basics and abilities to add max-health damage and melt the frontline in long fights
enemyKits.passive: Relentless stacks on hit and makes her basics deal bonus max-health damage
enemyKits.playWith: peel and a frontline, since her only escape is a short stealth
enemyKits.playAgainst: Heightened Senses is her only escape, a brief stealth with speed and no dash, so hard-engage her after it is used; Piercing Shot passes through terrain, so do not hide behind walls at low health

enemyKits.combo: Whispering Echoes or Anima Burst apply Soul Rip → Severance resets on Soul Rip targets → Soulstorm pulls them in and resets Severance
enemyKits.winCondition: chain Severance resets off Soul Rip to stick to a target and burst in melee
enemyKits.passive: casting an ability makes her next two basics ranged, faster and bouncing
enemyKits.playWith: follow-up CC to hold the target she dashes onto
enemyKits.playAgainst: her chain needs Soul Rip to reset Severance, so dodge Whispering Echoes and punish when Severance is on cooldown; walk out of Soulstorm before its pull, and buy anti-heal against Anima Burst

enemyKits.combo: Throw Alacrity for a shield and speed, place Consecrated Ground for ally attack speed and healing, fully charge Serenity for a stun, and use Reversal of Fortune to fly to an ally anywhere and knock up enemies on arrival.
enemyKits.winCondition: Keep the carry alive with shields and Reversal of Fortune saves while Sentinel cuts enemy healing.
enemyKits.passive: Sentinel: her damaging abilities cut enemy healing and her abilities boost allies' healing and shielding received.
enemyKits.playWith: A hyper-carry she can shield and a team that can follow her global ult into a fight.
enemyKits.playAgainst: Watch for the charging Serenity bolt and step out of its line before it reaches max charge. When Reversal of Fortune is down she cannot join distant fights, so pick off her side lanes then.

lines: Lead story: Stayed alive, joined every fight, and each takedown sped up the ultimate. In 68% of the team's kills (more than 94% of Lt. Belica mid players this patch) and died 1 time (fewer than about 89% of them). Lotus turned 17 takedowns into ability haste, so Neural Disruptor came back every ~54s instead of 85s.
Lesson: takedowns were the fuel. Each one Lt. Belica touched shortened Neural Disruptor, so feeding early made it come back faster (about 54.1s late); fight right after Neural Disruptor is spent.
Neural Disruptor at rank 3: 85s base, about 54.1s by the end (36% shorter) from 57 ability haste: Noxia 20, Soulbearer 8, Lotus 29.
17 takedowns (9 kills, 8 assists) fed: Lotus (Eternal).

Stack (Every ability hit set off): 3 effects on one trigger: Combustion, Noxia, Wraith Leggings. Lt. Belica has 4 damaging abilities (Void Bomb, Seismic Assault, Void Drone hit an area, so one cast sets them off on several heroes), and 57 ability haste brought them back 36% sooner: more casts, more triggers.
Stack (Kept alive in fights): 3 effects on one trigger: Noxia, Soulbearer, Lotus. Together they made staying in a long fight cheaper: more armor, shields or healing the longer it went.
The Eternal was part of it: Lotus (Masterpiece + Fragrance) sits on the same trigger as the items (kept alive in fights), so every extra second in a fight made them harder to kill.

evidence: 9/1/8, 30393 hero damage, the most in the game.
Hero damage per minute 1216 vs their Lt. Belica norm 789.

bullets: Noxia marks heroes hit by an ability; hitting a marked hero with a different ability, like Void Bomb then Seismic Assault, adds bonus damage on a cooldown.
Ability damage fires Combustion at the target and nearby enemies, on a cooldown that shrinks with hero hits; Wraith Leggings boosts ability damage on heroes below 40% health.
Lotus gave random bonuses over time and per takedown; Masterpiece stacked brief damage per kill; Fragrance raised magical damage on nearby heroes, boosting Void Bomb and Seismic Assault.

coachLean.headline: Five straight won fights each turned into a tower or Pit objective, and the enemy never won a single fight all game.

flags.text: Objective damage ran 57550 to 10855, and the squad took 8 structures to the enemy's 1.
Lt. Belica ran the game: 9/1/8, 30393 hero damage, 37% of the team's, the most in the game.
Enemy took the first Fangtooth; the squad then took two Fangtooths, Shaper, Orb Prime and Primal Fangtooth.
Vision clears lagged: the enemy destroyed 8 wards to the squad's 3 across the game.
